_note: Illustrative values for common orchard and orchard-floor nozzles at typical pressures. Droplet class follows the ASABE S572 categories; VMD is approximate. Check the manufacturer's chart for your exact tip and pressure.

nozzles.name: Disc-core hollow cone
nozzles.notes: Standard orchard airblast tip. Good coverage, high drift potential.

nozzles.name: Ceramic hollow cone
nozzles.notes: Very fine mist for dense canopies. Most drift-prone option.

nozzles.name: Air-induction hollow cone
nozzles.notes: Drift-reducing airblast tip. Larger, air-filled droplets.
